description: This file contains a class AST_Rewriter for performing AST transformations on functions, particularly rewriting assert statements and annotated assignments, and a RewritingTracer class that integrates with torch.fx to trace modules with rewritten ASTs. It also includes functions to rewrite modules or functions for symbolic tracing in PyTorch.

classes.name: AST_Rewriter
classes.description: A subclass of ast.NodeTransformer that rewrites assert statements and annotated assignments in Python AST for symbolic tracing.

classes.name: RewritingTracer
classes.description: A subclass of torch.fx._symbolic_trace.Tracer that applies AST rewriting during tracing.

methods.name: rewrite
methods.description: Rewrites a FunctionType object by parsing its source, transforming its AST, and recompiling it with the original globals.

methods.name: visit_Assert
methods.description: Replaces assert statements with calls to torch._assert for symbolic tracing.

methods.name: visit_AnnAssign
methods.description: Replaces annotated assignments with a call to an annotate function.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Overrides the trace method to apply AST rewriting before tracing.
